attempts.why: Use :nth-child(odd of :not([hidden])) so hidden/display:none rows are not counted, preserving correct zebra alternation.

selfVerify.reason: Zebra alternation is correct with hidden row excluded: r1 (striped rgba(111,120,135,0.04)), r2 (white), r3 (striped), r4 (white) with no consecutive duplicates, proving :nth-child(odd of :not([hidden])) is working and hidden display:none row at box 0,0,0x0 is not counted.

pick.suspected: `.striped` uses `tbody tr:nth-child(odd/even)` to set `rgba(111,120,135,0.04)` vs `white`. `:nth-child` counts the `hidden`/`display:none` row (nth-child 2), so r1 (nth-child 1) and r2 (nth-child 3) are both considered odd and get the same striped background `rgba(111, 120, 135, 0.04)` consecutively, breaking alternation (r3 white, r4 striped). Should use `:nth-child(odd of :not([hidden]))` / `:nth-child(even of :not([hidden]))` or exclude `[hidden]` rows to maintain correct zebra striping.
